review_candidates.title: Database Reliability Engineer
review_candidates.description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced PostgreSQL Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) / Senior DBA to take ownership of the reliability, performance, and scalability of our PostgreSQL databases running on Amazon Aurora and Amazon RDS. You will be the go-to PostgreSQL expert, working closely with our DevOps and Backend teams to optimize database performance, improve reliability, guide database architecture, and ensure our systems remain stable as data volumes and traffic grow. This is a highly specialized role focused on the database layer. Our DevOps team manages the underlying AWS infrastructure, while our Backend teams handle application development and queries. Key Responsibilities Optimize PostgreSQL internals and database configuration, including memory management, WAL settings, autovacuum, and other performance-related parameters. Manage vacuum, transaction ID wraparound, table/index bloat, and database maintenance in production environments. Monitor and optimize database connections and connection pooling in collaboration with the DevOps team, using solutions such as Amazon RDS Proxy or PgBouncer. Monitor database performance using AWS Performance Insights, CloudWatch, pg_stat_statements, auto_explain, and other observability tools. Analyze execution plans and work closely with Backend Engineers to identify performance bottlenecks, inefficient joins, missing indexes, locking issues, and other database-related problems. Provide guidance on advanced PostgreSQL database design, including partitioning, GIN/GiST indexes, JSONB optimization, and indexing strategies. Design and implement data archiving and retention strategies for large datasets ranging from hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes. Manage PostgreSQL replication, including logical replication, replication slots, replica lag, and integrations with data warehouses. Act as the Tier-3 escalation point for database-related production incidents. Diagnose and resolve complex issues such as deadlocks, long-running transactions, blocking DDL operations, replication problems, and unexpected CPU or resource spikes. Work with DevOps and Backend teams to establish database best practices and improve overall system reliability. Contribute to architectural decisions related to database scalability, availability, and performance. Requirements 5+ years of hands-on experience working with PostgreSQL in production environments. Strong understanding of PostgreSQL internals, performance tuning, maintenance, and troubleshooting. Solid experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and Amazon RDS. Strong understanding of AWS database concepts, including Aurora storage, failover mechanisms, replication, and Aurora Serverless. Experience with PostgreSQL performance analysis and tools such as EXPLAIN ANALYZE, pg_stat_statements, auto_explain, AWS Performance Insights, and CloudWatch. Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL indexing, partitioning, vacuum/autovacuum, WAL, replication, locking, and connection management. Experience working with large-scale databases and high-traffic production environments. Understanding of database reliability, high availability, and incident management. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with Backend and DevOps Engineers. Nice to Have Experience with PgBouncer or Amazon RDS Proxy. Experience with pg_repack, pg_squeeze, or similar database maintenance tools. Experience with logical replication and data warehouse integrations. Experience working with JSONB-heavy PostgreSQL databases. Experience with infrastructure-as-code environments such as Terraform. Experience designing PostgreSQL solutions for large datasets and high-throughput systems. What We Offer Competitive salary Flexible working hours Food vouchers Multisport card Internal & external training programs Team building activities & local company events Parking Bike-Friendly office

The Finaliser plays a critical role at the end of the creative workflow, ensuring that assets are print-ready, pixel-perfect, and brand-aligned—bridging the gap between design and production. Key Responsibilities • Prepare and finalize artwork files for print and digital platforms, ensuring compliance with technical and platform requirements. • Adjust layouts, typography, and visual elementsfor alignment, resolution, color consistency, and brand guidelines. • Convert design concepts into final mechanicals and production-ready files. • Conduct thorough checks for bleed, trims, image resolution, color modes (CMYK/RGB), and format integrity. • Collaborate with designers, art directors, and printers to resolve final-stage issues and maintain output quality. • Organize files systematically and support asset management practices for easy retrieval and reuse. • Apply revisions with speed and precision while keeping production timelines in mind. • Understand and support both English and Arabic finalization standards as needed. Required Qualifications • Diploma or degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or Print Production. • 2–4 years of experience in a studio, finalization, or production design role. • Familiarity with pre-press requirements, packaging, OOH formats, and digital media specs. • Basic knowledge of regional market practices and production standards in the UAE/GCC. • Fluency in English; Arabic reading knowledge is a plus. Experience & Skills • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop). • Knowledge of color correction, print setup, and digital output formatting. • Strong attention to typographic and visual detail. • Good understanding of file types, resolution, formats (PDF/X-1a, PNG, JPEG, etc.). • Ability to manage revisions, quality control, and delivery under tight deadlines. • Excellent organizational skills and a process-oriented mindset. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) • Technical accuracy of finalized assets. • Turnaround time for file delivery and revisions. • Compliance with brand, print, and digital specifications. • Reduction in production errors or rework. • Team feedback and collaboration performance.

review_candidates.title: Arabic and Islamic Studies Teacher
review_candidates.description: Together We Montessori Early Childhood Centre in Arjan, Dubai, is looking for a passionate and caring Arabic and Islamic Studies Teacher to join our growing team. The successful candidate will deliver engaging, age-appropriate Arabic and Islamic Studies lessons that encourage children’s language development, cultural awareness and understanding of Islamic values through stories, songs, conversations and interactive activities. Key responsibilities: Plan and deliver engaging Arabic and Islamic Studies lessons for early-years children. Create age-appropriate activities that support children’s communication and language development. Introduce Islamic values, manners and traditions in a warm and meaningful way. Adapt lessons to meet the different ages, abilities and learning needs of the children. Maintain lesson plans, observations and children’s progress records. Work collaboratively with teachers and the nursery leadership team. Build positive and respectful relationships with children and families. Follow all nursery safeguarding, health and safety, and KHDA requirements. Candidate requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Education, Arabic, Islamic Studies or a related field. Previous experience teaching Arabic and Islamic Studies, preferably within an early-years setting. Strong Arabic communication skills. Good command of English. A warm, patient and child-centred approach. Montessori or EYFS experience is an advantage. Previous KHDA approval is preferred, or the candidate must be eligible for KHDA approval. If you are passionate about inspiring young learners and would love to join a supportive and growing nursery community, we would be delighted to hear from you. Please apply through LinkedIn and submit your updated CV to info@togetherwemontessori.com. #Hiring #ArabicTeacher #IslamicStudiesTeacher #EarlyYearsJobs #NurseryJobs #DubaiJobs #Arjan #Montessori #EducationJobs
